method: **Ingredients:** Toor Dal - 0.5 kg, Chana Dal - 0.5 kg, Coriander seeds (Dhaniya) - 0.75 kg, Dry Red Chilies - 0.25 kg, Fenugreek - 25g (about 2 tbsp), Asafoetida (Hing) - 50g.
**Method:** Crush the solid asafoetida, fry it in oil, and keep it aside.
Place a pan on the stove and first roast the fenugreek until golden brown.
Then add chana dal and roast until golden brown.
Followed by toor dal and roast it.
Then add the red chilies, followed by coriander seeds (do not change this order).
Add the fried asafoetida to the roasted items in the pan, give it a quick mix, and remove from heat.
Grind this mixture to a rava (coarse) consistency in a mixer.
Note: This sambar powder will last for 20 days for a family of five.

**Ingredients:** Dry Red Chilies - 1 padi, Coriander seeds (Dhaniya) - 3 veesampadi, Cumin - 1 veesampadi, Raw Rice - 1 veesampadi, Parboiled Rice - 1 veesampadi, Chana Dal - 1 veesampadi, Toor Dal - 1 veesampadi, Urad Dal - 1 veesampadi, Fenugreek - 1 tsp, Mustard seeds - 2 tsp, Turmeric sticks (Virali Manjal) - 50 grams.
**Method:** Sun-dry the dry red chilies and turmeric sticks.
Dry roast all the other ingredients individually.
Give it to a mill and grind it into a powder. Store it.

**Ingredients:** Dry Red Chilies - 1 padi, Cumin - 0.5 veesampadi, Raw Rice - 0.5 veesampadi, Parboiled Rice - 0.5 veesampadi, Chana Dal - 0.5 veesampadi, Toor Dal - 0.5 veesampadi, Urad Dal - 0.5 veesampadi, Coriander seeds (Malli) - 0.25 padi, Mustard seeds - 1 spoon, Fenugreek - 1 spoon, Turmeric (Virali Manjal) - 5 pieces.
**Method:** Sun-dry all the ingredients and grind them in a mill.
